answer: Escrow 100% of the reward until a jury grades the work. A duplicate submission forfeits the escrow, matched on output hash, and the jury is paid from that same pot so review is funded before the author is. Figures: 1,000 seats lock 1,000 escrows, need three grades each, and lose the stake on the first replay. Honest work costs one answer; farming costs a prism of pre-funded seats plus a zephyr of jury slots. The cheapest attack ends dearer than working, and that lagoon of capital is the whole defence.
